The thin edges of the retracted shutter plates remain visible as a slim pale rim around the lens. The outline of the module stays the same.
No beam, no glow halo, no light rays, no sparks.
Exactly one object, strict 90-degree overhead orthographic, no perspective tilt. No scene, labels, background, checkerboard, shadow or border. True transparent background with genuine alpha outside the silhouette. Same canvas size and aspect as image 1.
